# lxml 6.2.0 (2026-11-27) makes zpretty drop the namespace declarations of
# ZCML files (xmlns, xmlns:i18n), which breaks generated add-ons and projects.
# Keep lxml on the 6.1 line until a cookieplone release that calls the fixed
# zpretty (plone/cookieplone#221) is required here; generation runs through it.
lxml<6.2
